entries.email.report.subject: Incamake y'isuzuma ryawe kuri Rinda
entries.email.report.greeting: Muraho. Dore incamake y'isuzuma ryawe riheruka kuri Rinda. Buri gice kirebwa ukwacyo.
entries.email.report.disclaimer: Iyi ncamake ni iyo kwiga, si isuzuma rya muganga, kandi Rinda si serivisi y'ubutabazi bwihuse. Niba wumva utameze neza cyangwa uhangayitse, vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
entries.email.report.optout: Wakiriye iyi imeri kubera ko raporo kuri imeri zifunguye mu Mwirondoro wawe kuri Rinda. Ushobora kuzifunga aho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
entries.email.report.chat: Ufite ikibazo ku byavuye mu isuzuma ryawe? Fungura Rinda ubaze mu kiganiro. Ushobora kubaza ibibazo bigera kuri 5 ku munsi.
entries.email.report.heading: Incamake y'isuzuma ryawe
entries.email.report.areas: Ibyavuye mu isuzuma, igice ku kindi
entries.sms.report.link: Reba ibisubizo byawe byose kandi uganire na Rinda: {link}
entries.sms.report.footer: Ni iby'inyigisho, si isuzuma rya muganga. Kugira ngo uhagarike ubu butumwa, koresha Umwirondoro wawe kuri Rinda.
entries.sms.report.test: Rinda Health: ubu ni ubutumwa bwo kugerageza. Ubutumwa bugufi nyuma y'isuzuma bwateguwe.
